mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1600 and retail sales below 480000 indicates broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1600 and RSAFS < 480000, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months) increase discount rates and reduce liquidity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) strengthens consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production below 100 and payroll growth below 150000 signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and PAYEMS < 150000, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion regimes (HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 485000) indicate overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.03.
